title: Support for Affected Customers in Cord Blood Storage Incident and Review of Obligations of Commercial Cord Blood Banks
what_it_is: Support for Affected Customers in Cord Blood Storage Incident and Review of Obligations of Commercial Cord Blood Banks

sections.label: Cordlife cord blood compensation questions
sections.summary: Questions ask whether the Ministry will assist customers with damaged cord blood units, its regulatory action, and strengthening provider refund obligations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health (a) whether the Ministry will assist customers whose cord blood units have been damaged while being stored by Cordlife with receiving a baseline level of compensation regardless of the type of service contract; (b) if so, how will this compensation be determined; and (c) if not, why not.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health (a) what is the precise scope and extent of the Ministry’s regulatory action in the Cordlife incident involving damaged cord blood units; (b) how will the Ministry further intervene following international experts’ criticism of Cordlife’s announced one-year timeline to complete significant testing of its cord blood samples; and (c) how will the Ministry assist unaffected parents who wish to transfer their cord blood units to another service provider for greater peace of mind.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health whether the Ministry will consider strengthening the obligations of commercial cord blood banking service providers to include the requirement of a full refund of the initial contract fees or other earlier payments when these service providers are found to be responsible for any damage to cord blood units under their care, rendering such units unsuitable for stem cell transplant services.

sections.label: Supervising further cord blood tests
sections.summary: The Ministry will supervise completion of further tests in the affected tanks to achieve high confidence in the findings.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The Ministry will be supervising the proper completion of further tests in the affected tanks to achieve a high level of confidence in the findings.

sections.label: One-year testing timeline considerations
sections.summary: The estimation of one year for completing the testing involves several operational considerations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The estimation of one year for the timeline for completing the testing involves several operational considerations.

sections.label: One-year timeline called reasonable
sections.summary: For these reasons and the subsequent assessment and review of results, the one-year timeline does appear reasonable.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, that small amount has to be dealt with in a very particular way.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, for all of these reasons and then, subsequently, the assessment and review of the results, it does appear that the one-year timeline is reasonable.

sections.label: Resident's $12,000 cord blood investment
sections.summary: A resident wrote that she and her husband invested $12,000 from their children's Child Development Account for cord blood bank services.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: A resident of mine wrote to me recently and informed me that she and her husband invested $12,000 from their children's Child Development Account for the cord blood bank services.

sections.label: Legislating refunds to CDA account
sections.summary: The question asks whether the Government will consider legislating a better protection regime for parents to recover all monies paid, including CDA refunds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: My second supplementary question is, moving forward, will the Government consider legislating a better protection regime for parents to recover all monies paid, including a refund to the CDA account for payments made when there are fundamental failures in the provision of blood cord services?

sections.label: Cord blood bank conditions
sections.summary: Each cord blood bank has indicated specific conditions must be met before accepting cord blood units from Cordlife.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I suspect Speaker's direction was also targeted to me.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: However, each of the cord blood banks has indicated that specific conditions must be met prior to accepting the cord blood units from Cordlife.

sections.label: Transfer process and viability risk
sections.summary: The three cord blood banks have transfer processes but accept only viable units, and parents face risk and time in transferring from Cordlife.

sentences.text: All of the three cord blood banks have processes in place to facilitate the transfer of the cord blood units, but they will only accept cord blood units that are demonstrated to be still viable and the receiving cord blood banks are unlikely able to guarantee the viability of cord blood units that are then transferred from Cordlife.
So, there is some risk to the customer, the parents associated with making the choice for this transfer and it will also take some time.
